Oloro Hybrid, by win line

Every card in the proposed deck, grouped by the win condition it serves, then the support that gets it there. Hybrid v3 list from October 11 with Sensei's Divining Top and Orcish Bowmasters out, Samut, Tyrant of Naktamun in, and Laboratory Maniac kept from the old deck.

Command zone

Oloro, Ageless Ascetic

Stays in the command zone almost every game: two life every upkeep whether he is cast or not. Every plan below spends that life.

  1. Oloro, Ageless Ascetic

    {3}{W}{U}{B}

    Gain 2 life at upkeep from the command zone. Cast him and each life gain also drains and draws.

    Commander

Plan 1

Win condition

Thassa's Oracle

Exile the library, Oracle enters, the game ends. Two mana, instant speed on the exile half, and the deck's main line in every sim run.

  1. Thassa's Oracle

    {U}{U}

    The win. Devotion to blue of zero beats an empty library.

    Ordered Oct 26

  2. Demonic Consultation

    {B}

    One mana, instant: name a card that is not in the deck and the library is gone.

    In the deck today

  3. Tainted Pact

    {1}{B}

    Second Consultation. Needs no two cards with the same name, so the basics must be unique.

    Still to buy, phase A to D

  4. Jace, Wielder of Mysteries

    {1}{U}{U}{U}

    Backup Oracle. Draw from an empty library and win instead of losing.

    In the deck today

  5. Laboratory Maniac

    {2}{U}

    Third Oracle body. Draw from an empty library and win. Kept from the old deck.

    In the deck today

  6. Spellseeker

    {2}{U}

    Finds Consultation, Tainted Pact or Angel's Grace on a body.

    Still to buy, phase A to D

Plan 2

Win condition

Ad Nauseam

Oloro's free life every upkeep becomes the whole library in hand. Angel's Grace makes the life total irrelevant for a turn.

  1. Ad Nauseam

    {3}{B}{B}

    Flip the deck into your hand, paying life per card.

    Ordered Oct 26

  2. Angel's Grace

    {W}

    Can't lose this turn, so Ad Nauseam takes everything.

    Ordered Oct 26

  3. Peer into the Abyss

    {4}{B}{B}{B}

    Half your life for half your library. Same shape, sorcery speed.

    Ordered Oct 26

  4. Necropotence

    {B}{B}{B}

    Pay life, draw that many at end step. The slow version of the same idea.

    Still to buy, phase A to D

Plan 3

Win condition

Citadel storm

Cast off the top of the library paying life, Oloro refuels it, Reservoir turns the storm count into fifty damage.

  1. Bolas's Citadel

    {3}{B}{B}{B}

    Play the top card of the library by paying life instead of mana.

    Still to buy, phase A to D

  2. Aetherflux Reservoir

    {4}

    Fifty life to deal fifty. Oloro gets there on his own.

    In the deck today

Plan 4

Win condition

The drain loop

The Oloro cards that came back for the hybrid. Any life gain with Exquisite Blood out and one of the three bond effects loops the table to zero.

  1. Exquisite Blood

    {4}{B}

    Opponent loses life, you gain that much.

    In the deck today

  2. Sanguine Bond

    {3}{B}{B}

    You gain life, target opponent loses that much. The classic half.

    In the deck today

  3. Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

    {2}{B}

    Sanguine Bond on a body. Also gives lifelink for a mana.

    In the deck today

  4. Bloodthirsty Conqueror

    {3}{B}{B}

    Third copy of the Bond effect, with a 5/5 flyer attached.

    In the deck today

Notes

Tainted Pact needs unique basics. The sim list runs three Islands and two Swamps. For paper, run one Island, one Snow-Covered Island, one Swamp, one Snow-Covered Swamp and one Plains, which frees one more slot.

Commander clause. Oloro stays in the command zone, so cards that need you to control a commander are not here (Deadly Rollick, Fierce Guardianship, Mox Amber).

Citadel storm after Top. With Sensei's Divining Top out, Plan 3 is Citadel plus Reservoir only. The sim treated Top as a second Citadel piece; it has not been rerun without it.

Where the list came from. oloro-hybrid-v3-list.txt (Downloads, October 11), identical to goldfish/decks/oloro-hybrid3.txt in the sim zip. Ownership tags: "in the deck today" means the card is in the old Oloro list the sim loaded on September 30; "ordered Oct 26" is the TCGplayer order history; "still to buy" is the transition checklist, phases A to G, which now covers every card in the list that is not already in the deck.

Cards shown twice (Spellseeker, Necropotence, Drannith Magistrate) are dimmed the second time and counted once.

Card images from Scryfall. Mana costs and types from Scryfall on October 28, 2026. Sim figures are from a plan-level simulator with a roughly 14-point error band in duels and no pod calibration; read them as direction, not forecast.
